scope: Proposal only; NOT_IMPLEMENTED and NOT_RUN; fixture results would not prove screenshot cause or mission acceptance
reuse: Extend joint coverage around existing real InputSystem/EventSystem ScrollRect fixture patterns in MatchHudSquadScrollTests and MatchHudSquadNativeScrollTests. Their UI-only swipes/taps are useful but not runtime camera/world-command assertions. A startup Camera object and method name RunGapInputCameraAndM5 do not establish those assertions.

setup: Isolated ECS world/session, actual tray/ScrollRect/GraphicRaycaster plus EventSystem/InputSystemUIInputModule, actual UI-start containment logic and runtime pointer input context wired to RtsSelectionInputCompositionSystemHelper.

Use a small real RtsCameraSystem/RtsCameraRequestSystem and fixed camera; count Pan requests and world move/attack/selection request buffers before applying any request. Observe after real EventSystem and runtime pointer updates in production order.

Pump AriaTouchInputUiSystemHelper contacts through distinct press/intermediate move/final move/release InputSystem/UI opportunities; no direct ScrollRect callbacks, normalized scroll writes or world order injection.
Baseline no follow/aircraft/preview/smooth camera writer. Pin per-file source and exact fixture context. Extra mode/flag changes are explicit synthetic stress controls, not normal-run observations.

cases.arrange: Start on real card and viewport gap; both LTR and RTL; move horizontally past drag threshold, optionally leave tray before release.
cases.assert: Roster moves when within valid ScrollRect route; no swipe card-select callback, no runtime Pan/world orders/selection rectangle; latched UI owner remains through contact; ordinary card tap still selects expected group.

cases.arrange: First seed dragging=true before a normal UI press: press must clear it. Separately set dragging=true AFTER an observed UI-origin press, with selection inactive and capture-ignore path absent, to model an explicit other-writer stress.
cases.assert: Current normal press control should remain pan-free. Held branch under synthetic post-press true flag can invoke Pan because no explicit UI predicate; record as conditional stress behavior only. A future defense must prevent it without blocking world-origin drag.

cases.arrange: Cancel mid-swipe using real TouchPhase.Canceled and separately remove the owned touch device/Stop; also leave fullscreen/build/support mode while held, with UI-owned origin.
cases.assert: No release click/world order/Pan from the canceled contact; drag/selection cleared and suppressed UI lifecycle settles. Next independent world-origin drag must still pan; UI-origin gesture must not inherit a prior mode flag. Verify no synthetic click from Stop/device removal.

cases.arrange: Start on unobstructed world, drag past threshold in a camera mode that allows pan, then release.
cases.assert: Nonzero intended Pan/camera delta, no UI scroll. This proves the negative fixture is wired and avoids a global input freeze masquerading as protection.

minimalFixture.boundedChecks: Record pointer/device/contact identity, latched origin/UI hit, input flags, camera dragging before/after writer, request kinds, frame ordering, ScrollRect delta, camera pose and accepted-command delta. Restore isolated fixture devices/world/EventSystem; no full mission needed for these controls.
